plan.concept: Translation of a 2D square from the origin in a Cartesian coordinate system by a translation vector t
plan.layout: single panel showing a 2D Cartesian coordinate system with a square translated from the origin

series.label: Original Square
series.note: Centered at (0,0) with black outline and orange fill

series.label: Translated Square
series.note: Centered at (4.0, 3.5) with black outline and orange fill

series.label: Translation Vector t
series.note: Red vector starting at the origin (0,0) and ending at the center of the translated square (4.0, 3.5) with a red arrowhead

panels.nodeDecorations: Squares have solid orange fill (#ff8500) and black borders

plan.colorScheme: White background, black axes (#1a1a1a), orange squares (#ff8500) with black borders, red translation vector (#ff0000)
plan.reconstructionNotes: Ensure the axes extend slightly into the negative domain to clearly show the origin (0,0) at the center of the first square. The translation vector arrow should end exactly at the center of the translated square. Use serif fonts for labels (x, y, t).
